# AppleTalk is a group audio meeting web application.
# Users create a meeting link, share it, and people join to talk or listen — audio only, no camera.

## What is AppleTalk?

AppleTalk (www.appletalk.live) is a group audio meeting platform.
A host creates a meeting and gets a shareable link. Anyone with the link can open it
in a browser and join. A limited number of speakers are heard at once while everyone
else listens, so meetings can scale to thousands of participants. There is no video.

## Key Features

- Shareable meeting links — create a room in one tap
- Audio only — no camera, no video
- Scales to thousands of participants (media server / SFU)
- Roles: host, speaker, and audience
- Raise hand to speak — audience requests the mic, host approves
- Host controls: mute, promote, demote, remove, end meeting
- Host-gated text chat and live emoji reactions
- Sign in with Google to host; join from a link in any browser

## Target Audience

- Teams running quick audio standups
- Communities hosting live audio rooms
- Organizers running town halls and webinars for large audiences

## How It Works

1. Sign in with Google and tap "New meeting"
2. AppleTalk generates a shareable meeting link
3. Share the link; participants open it and check their mic in a lobby
4. Participants join — host and speakers talk, audience listens
5. Audience members raise a hand to request the mic; the host promotes them
6. The host moderates with mute/promote/remove and can end the meeting for all

## Privacy

- Meeting audio streams live through the media server and is not recorded or stored
- No camera access is ever requested
- No data selling; only basic account and meeting records are kept to run the service

## URLs

- Homepage / Landing page: https://www.appletalk.live/
- App (dashboard): https://www.appletalk.live/
- Meeting link format: https://www.appletalk.live/room/<code>
